description: Does this payTo address belong to the domain? Evidence, not a guarantee. Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 at $0.002 USDC. Same resource URL as the REST route.

domain.description: Public hostname without a scheme. A scheme, port, path, and leading www. are stripped if present. After normalize: two or more DNS labels, each [a-z0-9] with optional interior hyphens (max 63 chars), total length at most 253. Empty input, literal IPs, and bare labels are rejected.

network.description: CAIP-2 of the live settlement network. Omit or send empty to use the configured default. A non-empty value must equal the schema enum exactly.

name: payto_check
